scientific_integrity: An exact finite moment calculation and a stationary-moment limit theorem are proved for a precisely defined two-zealot continuous-time voter chain. The embedded exact-rational checker covers nine small instances and does not establish the infinite result.
scientific_limitations: Only one red and one blue frozen agent in opposite parts of a complete bipartite graph, independent unit-rate updates, uniformly selected opposite neighbors, and nondegenerate proportional part-size limits. No full finite stationary distribution, quantitative convergence rate or arbitrary-graph theorem is asserted.
title: Opposed zealots produce a beta stationary law on bipartite voter networks
